3b72bc53ea5c.A Conditional Access policy that require: Conditional Access can require MFA at sign-in but does not remove standing role membership or add time-bound activation with approval.
3b72bc53ea5c.An access package in entitlement managem: Entitlement management grants access packages for groups, apps and sites, but just-in-time activation of directory roles is a PIM capability.
3b72bc53ea5c.Microsoft Entra ID Protection sign-in ri: ID Protection reacts to risky sign-ins and does not control how or when a privileged role is held.

08c6742885c4.A dynamic membership rule on the group: Dynamic rules add members based on attributes and give standing membership, not on-demand activation.
08c6742885c4.An Azure Policy assignment with a Modify: Azure Policy governs resource properties and cannot control group membership.
08c6742885c4.A role-assignable group with a permanent: Making a group role-assignable protects who can change it, but members still hold permanent access.

b076fa4936e3.Require multifactor authentication: The generic MFA control can be satisfied by SMS or voice, which are not phishing resistant.
b076fa4936e3.Require device to be marked as compliant: Device compliance checks the device state, not the authentication method used.
b076fa4936e3.Require approved client app: Approved client app applies to mobile apps and does not set the MFA method.

94723bdc9163.A one-time SMS code: SMS sign-in requires a phone method already registered and is not designed to bootstrap passwordless registration.
94723bdc9163.A temporary password with forced change: Issuing a password defeats the goal of a passwordless-from-day-one onboarding.
94723bdc9163.A software OATH token: An OATH token must first be registered and assigned, so it does not solve the first-day bootstrap problem.

640e1ad087c8.On the app registration Manifest page: The manifest describes the global application object, not per-tenant user assignment.
640e1ad087c8.On the app registration Expose an API pa: Expose an API defines scopes the app offers, not who may sign in.
640e1ad087c8.On the app registration Certificates and: Certificates and secrets hold the app's own credentials, not user access.

e5a35c37614a.Disable user consent completely, plus As: Disabling consent entirely blocks the low-impact verified apps you want to allow, and assignment does not handle consent requests.
e5a35c37614a.Allow user consent for all apps, plus ap: Allowing consent for all apps keeps the risk, and app instance property lock protects app properties, not consent.
e5a35c37614a.Block user consent, plus a Conditional A: Blocking consent stops the allowed scenario, and Conditional Access does not govern permission grants.

3cc87488218d.Reset the passwords of all affected user: A password reset does not remove an OAuth consent grant, so the app keeps its delegated access.
3cc87488218d.Delete the app registration from your ow: A multitenant attacker app is registered in the attacker's tenant, so it does not appear in your App registrations list.
3cc87488218d.Enable security defaults for the tenant: Security defaults enforce baseline MFA but do not revoke existing consent grants.

87a5311dfe58.Vault access policy: Access policies apply to the whole vault, cannot scope to a single secret and do not integrate with PIM.
87a5311dfe58.Shared access signature tokens: Key Vault does not use SAS tokens for data plane access.
87a5311dfe58.Storage account key authorization: Storage account keys are unrelated to Key Vault authorization.

a91402ed4c4e.Key Vault Secrets Officer: Secrets Officer can create, update and delete secrets, which is more than required.
a91402ed4c4e.Key Vault Contributor: Key Vault Contributor manages the vault resource on the management plane and does not grant data plane access to secrets.
a91402ed4c4e.Key Vault Reader: Key Vault Reader can read vault metadata but cannot read secret values.

39f22ab164eb.The role grants direct read access to ev: Key Vault Contributor does not grant data plane access by itself; the risk is that the user can add an access policy.
39f22ab164eb.The role allows purging the vault even w: Purge protection prevents purging during the retention period for every role.
39f22ab164eb.The role bypasses the Key Vault firewall: Role assignments do not exempt callers from the vault's network rules.

ab4a0ef0685c.Soft delete with 90-day retention and a: A resource lock protects the vault resource from deletion but not objects inside it from being purged.
ab4a0ef0685c.Purge protection disabled and an Azure B: Without purge protection, an administrator can purge a soft-deleted key immediately.
ab4a0ef0685c.Soft delete with 7-day retention and RBA: A 7-day retention does not meet the 90-day requirement.

8316cd43872c.Allow public access from all networks: Allowing all networks removes the firewall protection you just configured.
8316cd43872c.A service endpoint on the SQL server's s: An Azure SQL logical server is a PaaS resource and is not deployed into your subnet, so a service endpoint there does not help it.
8316cd43872c.A Key Vault access policy for the SQL se: Access policies grant permissions, not network access, and are not based on IP address.

47fb03982615.An Event Grid subscription that recreate: Event Grid can deliver near-expiry events but does not rotate keys on its own.
47fb03982615.An Azure Policy with a DeployIfNotExists: Azure Policy can audit key expiration settings, but rotation is configured in the key's rotation policy.
47fb03982615.A certificate issuance policy: Issuance policies apply to certificates, not to standalone keys.

a6b57179f822.Foundational CSPM: The free foundational CSPM tier does not include agentless secrets scanning or attack path analysis.
a6b57179f822.Defender for Storage: Defender for Storage protects storage accounts from threats and malware, not secrets on VMs.
a6b57179f822.Defender for Key Vault: Defender for Key Vault detects unusual access to vaults, not secrets left on machines.

c7b34079d66f.It scans secret values to detect weak pa: The plan does not evaluate the strength of secret values.
c7b34079d66f.It must be enabled separately on each ke: The plan is enabled per subscription in Defender for Cloud and does not depend on diagnostic settings.
c7b34079d66f.It blocks the suspicious caller automati: Defender for Key Vault alerts and recommends response steps; it does not block callers by itself.

b3f186549bd5.Audit: Audit only logs noncompliance and does not stop new noncompliant accounts.
b3f186549bd5.Modify: Modify changes resource properties and would alter accounts instead of just blocking creation.
b3f186549bd5.DeployIfNotExists: DeployIfNotExists deploys related resources and does not block a noncompliant request.

1407e51359b9.Modify effects cannot run on existing re: Existing resources are remediated through remediation tasks, so Modify does apply to them.
1407e51359b9.Remediation tasks require the Deny effec: Deny cannot be remediated; remediation tasks exist for Modify and DeployIfNotExists.
1407e51359b9.The policy must be assigned at the tenan: Remediation works at any assignment scope as long as the identity has permissions.

7e8951dbe10c.Deny: Deny evaluates create and update requests, not delete operations.
7e8951dbe10c.Audit: Audit only records noncompliance and does not stop a delete.
7e8951dbe10c.Append: Append adds fields during create or update and cannot block deletion.

bee54e46d1ea.A new assignment with enforcement mode s: DoNotEnforce disables enforcement for the whole assignment, not just one resource group.
bee54e46d1ea.A notScopes entry on the assignment: notScopes permanently excludes the scope with no reason, category or expiry.
bee54e46d1ea.A resource lock on the resource group: Locks protect resources from changes and have nothing to do with policy compliance.

f933afde009f.Assign the Microsoft cloud security benc: The Microsoft cloud security benchmark is the default standard but does not present results mapped to PCI DSS controls.
f933afde009f.Create a custom role with Microsoft.Secu: A custom role only controls who can view data; it does not add a compliance standard.
f933afde009f.Enable Defender for Servers Plan 1 only: A workload protection plan does not add a regulatory standard to the dashboard.

0411510ff573.A custom Azure Policy initiative only: An Azure Policy initiative works for Azure-only custom recommendations, but it is not a KQL query against the security graph.
0411510ff573.Foundational CSPM with the Microsoft clo: Foundational CSPM does not allow KQL-based custom recommendations.
0411510ff573.A workbook in Azure Monitor: A workbook visualizes data but does not create a recommendation.

aa1018f0801d.ReadOnly locks block all data plane read: Locks apply to the management plane and do not directly block data plane reads such as Entra-authorized blob access.
aa1018f0801d.Contributor cannot read blob data under: Contributor can list keys normally; it is the lock that prevents the listKeys call.
aa1018f0801d.ReadOnly locks revoke existing SAS token: Locks do not invalidate SAS tokens that were already issued.

690a9f5c10b6.No, because NotActions blocks the operat: NotActions is not a deny assignment and does not override other roles.
690a9f5c10b6.No, because custom roles take precedence: Azure RBAC has no precedence between custom and built-in roles; permissions are summed.
690a9f5c10b6.Yes, but only after a PIM activation: Nothing in the scenario involves PIM; the permission is already granted by Contributor.

7fbfe482cdcf.An Azure custom role assigned at the sub: Azure custom roles control Azure resources, not Entra objects such as app registrations.
7fbfe482cdcf.The Application Administrator role assig: Application Administrator tenant wide manages all applications, which is broader than required.
7fbfe482cdcf.The Cloud Application Administrator role: Cloud Application Administrator tenant wide also covers all apps, which violates least privilege.

ee782834b045.Keep Owner but add a CanNotDelete lock o: A lock prevents deletion but leaves Owner's ability to manage access and all resources.
ee782834b045.Replace Owner with Contributor at the su: Contributor is still far broader than needed for VM management.
ee782834b045.Create a deny assignment for Microsoft.A: You cannot create custom deny assignments directly, and that approach would not right-size access.

2ef14c484911.User Access Administrator at the subscri: User Access Administrator can assign any role, including Owner.
2ef14c484911.Owner with a CanNotDelete lock: Owner can assign any role and a lock does not change that.
2ef14c484911.A Microsoft Entra custom role scoped to: Entra custom roles do not control Azure resource role assignments.

d1b68cc60eef.Cross Region Restore: Cross Region Restore helps with regional outages, not with malicious deletion.
d1b68cc60eef.Instant restore snapshots: Instant restore snapshots speed up restores but can be deleted along with backups.
d1b68cc60eef.Geo-redundant storage: Geo-redundant storage replicates data but deletions are replicated too.

6e8b1a9cbc8d.Immutable vault in the Unlocked state: In the Unlocked state immutability can still be disabled, so it is not irreversible.
6e8b1a9cbc8d.Multi-user authorization with Resource G: Multi-user authorization requires a second approver but does not make the protection permanent.
6e8b1a9cbc8d.Soft delete with 14-day retention: Soft delete protects deleted data for a period but does not stop retention from being reduced.

e7011b32682e.A CanNotDelete lock on the vault: A lock blocks vault deletion but not operations such as disabling soft delete.
e7011b32682e.PIM eligible assignment of Backup Contri: PIM limits standing access but the backup admin could still perform the operation alone after activation.
e7011b32682e.An Azure Policy with the Deny effect ass: Azure Policy does not provide a separate approval step for vault operations.

42fcd6bd8c4d.Enable Defender for Resource Manager on: Defender for Resource Manager detects suspicious management operations at runtime, not template issues before deployment.
42fcd6bd8c4d.Assign Azure Policy definitions with the: Azure Policy evaluates deployed or deploying resources, not templates in pull requests.
42fcd6bd8c4d.Enable Azure Monitor change analysis: Change analysis tracks changes after deployment and does not scan code.

34f2c4a41cdc.Account SAS: An account SAS is signed with the account key, so it is rejected once Shared Key is disallowed.
34f2c4a41cdc.Service SAS: A service SAS is also signed with the account key and is rejected.
34f2c4a41cdc.Service SAS tied to a stored access poli: Associating a service SAS with a stored access policy does not change that it is signed with the account key.

ab6bff92f93a.Delete the container's stored access pol: The SAS is not linked to a stored access policy, so deleting policies does not revoke it.
ab6bff92f93a.Remove the partner's RBAC role assignmen: SAS access does not depend on RBAC assignments, so removing a role has no effect on the token.
ab6bff92f93a.Change the container's public access lev: Public access settings do not invalidate a valid SAS.

49251c256526.A user delegation key with a 7-day lifet: User delegation SAS cannot be associated with a stored access policy, and revoking it requires revoking the delegation key.
49251c256526.An account SAS with HTTPS only: An account SAS cannot use a stored access policy and can only be revoked by rotating keys.
49251c256526.Immutable storage with a time-based rete: Immutable storage protects blobs from modification and does not manage SAS tokens.

71b1ca10599e.Storage Account Contributor scoped to th: Storage Account Contributor is a management plane role that can list keys and gives far more access than needed.
71b1ca10599e.Storage Blob Data Owner scoped to the su: Data Owner at the subscription covers every account and also manages POSIX ACLs, which is excessive.
71b1ca10599e.Reader scoped to the container: Reader is a management plane role and does not grant blob data access.

5d3bdd71fb0c.Allow Azure services on the trusted serv: The trusted services exception allows any trusted service instance, which is broader than one workspace.
5d3bdd71fb0c.An IP rule with the Synapse service tag: Storage IP rules accept public IP addresses and ranges, not service tags.
5d3bdd71fb0c.A service endpoint on the Synapse manage: You cannot add service endpoints to a Microsoft-managed virtual network that you do not control.

be3b9cd31231.Sensitive data threat detection in Defen: Sensitive data threat detection prioritizes alerts on accounts with sensitive data and does not scan for malware.
be3b9cd31231.Microsoft Defender Antivirus on the app': Antivirus on the VM does not scan blobs that clients upload directly to storage.
be3b9cd31231.Soft delete for blobs: Soft delete helps recover deleted data and performs no scanning.

c098146db586.Configure the storage firewall to block: The storage firewall filters network sources and cannot act on individual blobs.
c098146db586.Enable the built-in auto-quarantine opti: There is no auto-quarantine setting on the Data protection page; that page manages features such as soft delete and versioning.
c098146db586.Assign an Azure Policy with a Modify eff: Azure Policy changes resource configuration, not individual blob contents.

0384d693810d.On-upload malware scanning: Malware scanning looks for malicious content, not sensitive data types.
0384d693810d.Activity monitoring only: Activity monitoring raises alerts but does not add sensitivity context by itself.
0384d693810d.Storage account key rotation reminders: Key rotation reminders are a key management feature, not threat detection.

f95621536057.Blob soft delete with 365-day retention: Soft delete only allows recovery for a time and blobs can still be overwritten or purged.
f95621536057.A CanNotDelete lock on the storage accou: Resource locks protect the account on the management plane but not individual blobs.
f95621536057.Blob versioning combined with lifecycle: Versioning keeps previous versions, but they can still be deleted.

e22ee593eb4f.A server-level firewall rule that denies: Firewall rules control network sources, not the authentication method.
e22ee593eb4f.Always Encrypted with secure enclaves: Always Encrypted protects column data and does not control sign-in methods.
e22ee593eb4f.Transparent data encryption with a custo: TDE encrypts data at rest and has no effect on authentication.

797982ee72ce.Premium SKU and HSM-only keys: Both software-protected and HSM-protected keys are supported, so Premium is not required.
797982ee72ce.Public network access disabled: Disabling public access is a good practice but is not required for TDE with CMK.
797982ee72ce.Access policy permission model only: Both RBAC and access policies are supported for granting the server access to the key.

b208f3ef9b86.Dynamic data masking: Dynamic data masking hides values in query results but privileged users and admins can still see the data.
b208f3ef9b86.Transparent data encryption: TDE encrypts data at rest only and decrypts it for anyone who can query it.
b208f3ef9b86.Row-level security: Row-level security filters rows by user but does not hide values in permitted rows from admins.

693c81ea4793.Only database-level auditing applies bec: Database auditing does not override server auditing; they run side by side.
693c81ea4793.Only server-level auditing applies becau: Server auditing does not override database settings; both apply.
693c81ea4793.The configuration fails validation and a: Both configurations are valid and are applied together.

b38f74b88031.Enable server-level auditing in the port: Managed Instance auditing is configured with T-SQL server audits, not the SQL Database portal auditing blade.
b38f74b88031.Create a server audit TO URL pointing to: TO URL writes audit files to Azure Blob Storage, not to a Log Analytics workspace.
b38f74b88031.Install the Azure Monitor Agent on the m: Managed Instance is a PaaS service where you do not install agents.

008c59e0bf5b.Classic configuration: Classic configuration requires a storage account to store scan results.
008c59e0bf5b.Microsoft Defender for Storage: Defender for Storage protects storage accounts and does not run SQL vulnerability scans.
008c59e0bf5b.SQL Server agent jobs: Agent jobs are not how Defender for SQL runs vulnerability assessments on Azure SQL Database.

d75b028212fb.Defender for Azure SQL Databases togethe: Defender for Azure SQL Databases covers Azure SQL, and Defender for Storage covers storage accounts.
d75b028212fb.Defender for SQL servers on machines wit: SQL servers on machines protects SQL Server on VMs and Arc, not PaaS PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
d75b028212fb.Defender CSPM only: Defender CSPM provides posture, not runtime threat detection for databases.

95d627621065.It is denied because deny rules always w: Deny rules do not take precedence over allow rules; priority decides.
95d627621065.It is denied because rule 300 is more sp: NSGs do not use specificity; they use priority order.
95d627621065.It is allowed only if the default AllowV: Internet traffic does not match AllowVnetInBound, and the explicit rule already matched.

18dbcce88c0c.Service tags as source and destination: Service tags represent Azure service IP ranges, not your own VM tiers.
18dbcce88c0c.A separate route table for each tier: Route tables control next hops and cannot filter traffic between tiers.
18dbcce88c0c.Azure Virtual Network Manager connectivi: Connectivity configurations build topologies such as hub and spoke and do not filter by tier.

4e4320579344.An NSG with a priority 100 deny rule app: Teams that own the subnets can edit or replace NSGs, so the rule can be overridden.
4e4320579344.An Azure Policy that audits NSG rules: An Audit policy reports noncompliance but does not block traffic.
4e4320579344.Azure Firewall DNAT rules: DNAT rules translate inbound traffic through the firewall and do not block SSH reaching VMs with public IPs.

37385df555c5.Allow: Allow lets the traffic continue to the NSG, which could still deny it.
37385df555c5.Deny: Deny blocks the traffic, the opposite of what is needed.
37385df555c5.Audit: Audit is not a security admin rule action; the actions are Allow, Always Allow and Deny.

38ab00b33775.A user-defined route on every spoke subn: UDRs in spokes do not control hub routing for branch traffic and are error prone at scale.
38ab00b33775.A route table with a 0.0.0.0/0 route onl: A default route only covers internet-bound traffic, not private traffic.
38ab00b33775.NSG flow logs on the hub: Flow logs record traffic but do not route it through the firewall.

c4771edfc25c.IKEv2 tunnel type with Microsoft Entra I: Entra ID authentication is not supported with IKEv2.
c4771edfc25c.SSTP tunnel type with certificate authen: Certificate authentication does not use Entra accounts or Conditional Access.
c4771edfc25c.IKEv2 tunnel type with RADIUS authentica: RADIUS could integrate with other directories but does not use Entra sign-in directly.

3b59781fb831.A policy-based VPN gateway with default: Default settings use Azure's proposals, which may not match the required algorithms.
3b59781fb831.BGP on the connection: BGP exchanges routes and does not set encryption algorithms.
3b59781fb831.Forced tunneling: Forced tunneling routes internet traffic on-premises and has no effect on crypto settings.

31686368f07c.Azure VPN Gateway with certificate authe: A VPN gives network-level access and cannot apply Conditional Access per app with certificate authentication.
31686368f07c.Azure Bastion with native client support: Bastion provides RDP and SSH to Azure VMs, not general on-premises app access.
31686368f07c.Azure Front Door with Private Link origi: Front Door publishes web apps to the internet and is not a VPN replacement for private apps.

a1dfc5c0ad9f.Per-app access with a separate enterpris: Per-app access gives finer control but takes more setup, which is the later step.
a1dfc5c0ad9f.Application Proxy with pre-authenticatio: Application Proxy publishes web apps, not broad IP ranges for any protocol.
a1dfc5c0ad9f.Entra Internet Access web content filter: Internet Access filters internet traffic, not access to private resources.

63123df458fa.Enable a Microsoft.Storage service endpo: Service endpoints use the public endpoint and do not change DNS resolution to the private IP.
63123df458fa.Add the client subnet to the storage fir: Firewall rules affect access, not name resolution.
63123df458fa.Disable private endpoint network policie: Network policies control NSGs and UDRs on the endpoint, not DNS.

cee61d599043.Assign an ASG to the private endpoint NI: ASGs can be used with private endpoints, but rules apply only after network policies are enabled on the subnet.
cee61d599043.Add a service endpoint for the service: Service endpoints are a different feature and do not make NSGs apply to private endpoints.
cee61d599043.Disable the storage account's public end: Disabling public access helps security but does not make NSGs filter private endpoint traffic.

5bc33dc38611.A VNet peering to each customer: Peering exposes whole networks and has overlapping address and governance issues.
5bc33dc38611.A public IP with an NSG allow list: A public IP keeps the service on the internet.
5bc33dc38611.A service endpoint policy: Service endpoint policies filter egress to Azure Storage and do not publish services.

8cc71212771b.NAT IP configuration and TCP proxy v2: NAT IP and proxy protocol settings handle addressing and source IP, not who can connect.
8cc71212771b.Private DNS zone group and ASG: DNS zone groups and ASGs are consumer-side or filtering features, not access controls on the service.
8cc71212771b.Load balancer health probe and session p: Health probes and persistence are load balancer behaviors.

3df9ef39175b.Standard: Standard supports FQDN filtering and threat intelligence but not TLS inspection or IDPS.
3df9ef39175b.Basic: Basic is for small businesses and lacks these advanced features.
3df9ef39175b.Standard with threat intelligence in Ale: Threat intelligence filtering blocks known malicious IPs and domains but does not provide TLS inspection or URL path filtering.

82f2ef7cd9fb.Network rules, then DNAT rules, then app: DNAT rules come before network rules.
82f2ef7cd9fb.All rules are processed together by prio: Rule collection type order applies first; priority applies within each type.

814393c98582.A private DNS zone linked to the firewal: A private DNS zone does not make clients and the firewall share resolution results.
814393c98582.An NSG rule allowing UDP 53 to Azure DNS: Allowing DNS through an NSG does not make the firewall see the resolutions.
814393c98582.A forced tunneling route to on-premises: Forced tunneling changes routing and does not enable DNS proxy.

6038f0607a8b.Next hop: Next hop shows routing, not NSG decisions.
6038f0607a8b.Connection monitor: Connection monitor tracks reachability over time but does not name the NSG rule for a flow.
6038f0607a8b.VNet flow logs: Flow logs record past traffic and require analysis to infer rule behavior.

5ac221474dbf.IP flow verify: IP flow verify tests one flow and does not list all rules.
5ac221474dbf.Packet capture: Packet capture records traffic and does not list rules.
5ac221474dbf.Next hop for the NIC's subnet: Next hop shows the routing decision for a destination.

559d71b2ffb3.Microsoft Entra access reviews for Micro: Access reviews attest group membership but do not show site-level sharing to EEEU or sharing links.
559d71b2ffb3.The Defender for Cloud regulatory compli: The compliance dashboard covers Azure resource posture, not SharePoint permissions.
559d71b2ffb3.Microsoft Purview eDiscovery content sea: Content search finds items for legal holds and exports, not oversharing patterns.

efb2b866b0e4.Delete the site and restore it later: Deleting the site removes access for legitimate members.
efb2b866b0e4.A Conditional Access policy for SharePoi: Conditional Access controls sign-in conditions to SharePoint, not whether a site's content appears in Copilot.
efb2b866b0e4.Disable the Microsoft 365 Copilot licens: Removing all Copilot licenses is disproportionate and does not fix the oversharing.

995aa18ba660.Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps sessio: Session policies control sessions to cloud apps but do not provide AI-specific data risk assessments.
995aa18ba660.Microsoft Entra ID Protection: ID Protection detects identity risk, not sensitive data use in AI apps.
995aa18ba660.Defender for Cloud Data and AI security: The Defender for Cloud dashboard covers Azure data and AI resources, not Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts.

617f27c62988.Copilot Studio agent settings, Generativ: Content moderation in an agent controls response filtering, not external threat detection.
617f27c62988.Microsoft Entra admin center, Enterprise: Conditional Access does not connect Copilot Studio to an external security provider.
617f27c62988.Microsoft 365 admin center, Agents, Sett: The Microsoft 365 admin center manages agent availability, not the Copilot Studio threat detection webhook.

2907038ac51a.The tool call is blocked until the provi: Blocking is not the default; it must be configured through error behavior.
2907038ac51a.The agent retries the call three times a: There is no documented retry-then-block behavior.
2907038ac51a.The conversation ends and an alert is ra: The default is to continue the conversation, not end it.

cd71c33b0498.All users: Policies targeting all users do not include agent identities or agent user accounts.
cd71c33b0498.A group containing the agent's user acco: Including or excluding agent user accounts by group membership is not supported, and the flow uses the agent identity, not its user account.
cd71c33b0498.The signed-in user who invoked the agent: In an app-only flow there is no signed-in user, so user-targeted policies do not apply.

d41120bf8991.Rotate the agent's credentials: Credential and authentication settings are owner responsibilities.
d41120bf8991.Re-enable the agent after investigation: Only owners or admins can re-enable a disabled agent identity.
d41120bf8991.Hard-delete the agent identity: Hard-delete is reserved for owners and administrators.

0f62ca3daf60.Application permissions expire after one: Tokens expire, but the permission grant does not, so expiry does not reduce blast radius.
0f62ca3daf60.Delegated permissions always require adm: Many delegated permissions can be user consented; consent type is not what defines blast radius.
0f62ca3daf60.Application permissions cannot be audite: Use of application permissions is logged and can be audited.

bc96f4126cc0.rate-limit-by-key: rate-limit-by-key counts calls, not tokens consumed.
bc96f4126cc0.llm-emit-token-metric: llm-emit-token-metric sends token usage metrics but does not enforce limits.
bc96f4126cc0.quota-by-key: quota-by-key counts calls or bandwidth, not LLM tokens.

b4315e02f5f7.validate-content: validate-content checks payloads against schemas and size, not harmful content.
b4315e02f5f7.llm-semantic-cache-lookup: Semantic cache lookup returns cached responses and does not moderate prompts.
b4315e02f5f7.ip-filter: ip-filter restricts callers by IP address.

12acddc15f80.A groundedness control at the output int: Groundedness applies to models, not agents, and checks output, not tool responses.
12acddc15f80.A content harms control on user input on: Scanning only user input misses injected content returned by tools.
12acddc15f80.A protected material control with the An: Protected material checks copyrighted text and code, and Annotate alone is available only for models.

d2c0a5405b0b.Both guardrails, with the strictest sett: Guardrails are not merged; the agent guardrail replaces the model's.
d2c0a5405b0b.Only the model deployment's guardrail: The model's guardrail is used only when the agent has no guardrail of its own.
d2c0a5405b0b.Microsoft.DefaultV2 always applies to ag: DefaultV2 applies to an agent only if its model uses it or it is assigned explicitly.

3cf19134639f.Diagnostic logs on the Azure OpenAI reso: Diagnostic logs do not add prompt evidence to Defender alerts.
3cf19134639f.Data security for AI interactions with M: The Purview integration shares prompts with Purview for data security, not alert evidence.
3cf19134639f.Defender CSPM sensitive data discovery: Sensitive data discovery classifies data stores and does not change AI alerts.

e3171850229e.The Workload protections dashboard with: The workload protections view does not focus on data and AI resources, and Servers Plan 2 does not cover them.
e3171850229e.The regulatory compliance dashboard with: Regulatory compliance maps controls to standards, not data and AI risks.
e3171850229e.Azure Monitor workbooks that query a Log: A custom workbook would not provide Defender's sensitive data and AI threat insights by itself.

cc9df25b5227.Restore the creator's account so the age: Restoring the account is not the documented way to manage ownerless agents.
cc9df25b5227.Use Entra Conditional Access to hide the: Conditional Access does not control visibility of agents in Microsoft 365.
cc9df25b5227.Use Purview retention to expire the agen: Retention policies apply to content, not agent availability.

4a51b61fc28e.BitLocker inside the guest OS: BitLocker inside the guest is what ADE uses and consumes VM CPU.
